    def to_markdown(report: Report) -> str:
    """Render a report as Markdown.

    Parameters
    ----------
    report : Report
        The report.

    Returns
    -------
    str
        Markdown text.
    """
    t = report.text
    lines = [f"# {report.title}", "", f"*{t('tagline')}*", "", f"## {t('summary')}", "", report.summary, ""]
    lines += [f"*{report.by_line}*", ""]
    lines += [f"## {t('scores')}", "", "| " + " | ".join(t(k) for _, k in COLUMNS) + " |", "|---" * len(COLUMNS) + "|"]
    lines += ["| " + " | ".join(r[c] for c, _ in COLUMNS) + " |" for r in report.rows]
    if report.experiments:
        lines += ["", f"## {t('tried')}", "", t("tried_intro"), ""] + [f"- {x}" for x in report.experiments]
    lines += ["", f"## {t('notes')}", ""]
    for kind, heading in NOTE_GROUPS:
        notes = [n for n in report.notes if n.kind == kind]
        if notes:
            lines += [f"### {t(heading)}", ""]
            lines += [f"- **{n.text}**{_cite(n)}" + (f"  \n  {n.detail}" if n.detail else "") for n in notes]
            lines.append("")
    if report.refs:
        lines += [f"## {t('refs')}", ""]
        lines += [f"- [{r['key']}] {r['label']}: {r['title']}. {r['url']}" for r in report.refs]
        lines.append("")
    lines += [f"## {t('versions')}", ""] + [f"- {k}: {v}" for k, v in report.versions.items()]
    lines += ["", f"## {t('disclaimer')}", "", report.disclaimer, ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)

    def to_html(report: Report) -> str:
    """Render a report as a standalone HTML page with a print stylesheet.

    Parameters
    ----------
    report : Report
        The report.

    Returns
    -------
    str
        HTML text.
    """
    e, t = html.escape, report.text
    head = "".join(f"<th>{e(t(k))}</th>" for _, k in COLUMNS)
    rows = "".join("<tr>" + "".join(f"<td>{e(r[c])}</td>" for c, _ in COLUMNS) + "</tr>" for r in report.rows)
    tried = ""
    if report.experiments:
        tried = (
            f'<h2>{e(t("tried"))}</h2><p class="note">{e(t("tried_intro"))}</p><ul>'
            + "".join(f"<li>{e(x)}</li>" for x in report.experiments)
            + "</ul>"
        )
    notes = ""
    for kind, heading in NOTE_GROUPS:
        items = [n for n in report.notes if n.kind == kind]
        if items:
            notes += (
                f"<h3>{e(t(heading))}</h3><ul>"
                + "".join(
                    f"<li><strong>{e(n.text)}</strong>{e(_cite(n))}"
                    + (f'<br><span class="note">{e(n.detail)}</span>' if n.detail else "")
                    + "</li>"
                    for n in items
                )
                + "</ul>"
            )
    refs = "".join(
        f'<li>[{e(r["key"])}] {e(r["label"])}: <a href="{e(r["url"])}">{e(r["title"])}</a></li>' for r in report.refs
    )
    versions = "".join(f"<li>{e(k)}: {e(v)}</li>" for k, v in report.versions.items())
    figure = ""
    if report.frame:
        data = base64.b64encode(report.frame).decode("ascii")
        figure = (
            f'<figure><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,{data}" alt="{e(report.frame_caption)}">'
            f'<figcaption class="note">{e(report.frame_caption)}</figcaption></figure>'
        )
    return f"""<!doctype html>
<html lang="{e(report.language)}"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>{e(report.title)}</title>
<style>
body{{font:15px/1.55 "Open Sans",-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;color:#15140f;background:#fff;max-width:860px;margin:32px auto;padding:0 16px}}
h1{{font-size:26px}} h2{{font-size:19px;margin-top:28px}} h3{{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:4px}}
table{{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:13px}} th,td{{border-bottom:1px solid #e4e4e0;padding:6px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}}
.note{{color:#6e6e73}} figure{{margin:16px 0}} img{{max-width:100%;border-radius:12px}} @media print{{body{{margin:0}} a{{color:inherit}}}}
</style></head><body>
<h1>{e(report.title)}</h1><p class="note"><em>{e(t("tagline"))}</em></p>
<h2>{e(t("summary"))}</h2><p>{e(report.summary)}</p><p class="note"><em>{e(report.by_line)}</em></p>
<h2>{e(t("scores"))}</h2><table><tr>{head}</tr>{rows}</table>
{figure}
{tried}
<h2>{e(t("notes"))}</h2>{notes}
<h2>{e(t("refs"))}</h2><ul>{refs}</ul>
<h2>{e(t("versions"))}</h2><ul>{versions}</ul>
<h2>{e(t("disclaimer"))}</h2><p class="note">{e(report.disclaimer)}</p>
</body></html>
"""

    def to_pdf(report: Report) -> bytes:
    """Render a report as PDF with ReportLab.

    Parameters
    ----------
    report : Report
        The report.

    Returns
    -------
    bytes
        PDF file content.
    """
    from reportlab.lib import colors  # noqa: PLC0415
    from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4  # noqa: PLC0415
    from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet  # noqa: PLC0415
    from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph, SimpleDocTemplate, Spacer, Table, TableStyle  # noqa: PLC0415

    styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
    e, t = html.escape, report.text
    small = styles["BodyText"].clone("small", fontSize=8, leading=10)
    story: list[Any] = [
        Paragraph(e(report.title), styles["Title"]),
        Paragraph(f"<i>{e(t('tagline'))}</i>", styles["Normal"]),
    ]
    story += [
        Spacer(1, 8),
        Paragraph(e(t("summary")), styles["Heading2"]),
        Paragraph(e(report.summary), styles["Normal"]),
    ]
    story += [Spacer(1, 4), Paragraph(f"<i>{e(report.by_line)}</i>", small)]
    data = [[Paragraph(e(t(k)), small) for _, k in COLUMNS]] + [
        [Paragraph(e(r[c]), small) for c, _ in COLUMNS] for r in report.rows
    ]
    table = Table(data, colWidths=[55, 50, 50, 130, 140, 55])
    table.setStyle(
        TableStyle([("LINEBELOW", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.25, colors.grey), ("VALIGN", (0, 0), (-1, -1), "TOP")])
    )
    story += [Paragraph(e(t("scores")), styles["Heading2"]), table]
    if report.frame:
        from PIL import Image as PILImage  # noqa: PLC0415
        from reportlab.platypus import Image  # noqa: PLC0415

        with PILImage.open(io.BytesIO(report.frame)) as img:
            ratio = img.height / img.width
        story += [Spacer(1, 8), Image(io.BytesIO(report.frame), width=440, height=440 * ratio)]
        story.append(Paragraph(e(report.frame_caption), small))
    if report.experiments:
        story += [Paragraph(e(t("tried")), styles["Heading2"]), Paragraph(e(t("tried_intro")), small)]
        story += [Paragraph("• " + e(x), styles["Normal"]) for x in report.experiments]
    story.append(Paragraph(e(t("notes")), styles["Heading2"]))
    for kind, heading in NOTE_GROUPS:
        items = [n for n in report.notes if n.kind == kind]
        if items:
            story.append(Paragraph(e(t(heading)), styles["Heading3"]))
        for n in items:
            story.append(Paragraph(f"<b>{e(n.text)}</b>{e(_cite(n))}", styles["Normal"]))
            if n.detail:
                story.append(Paragraph(e(n.detail), small))
            story.append(Spacer(1, 4))
    if report.refs:
        story.append(Paragraph(e(t("refs")), styles["Heading2"]))
        story += [Paragraph(e(f"[{r['key']}] {r['label']}: {r['title']}. {r['url']}"), small) for r in report.refs]
    story.append(Paragraph(e(t("versions")), styles["Heading2"]))
    story += [Paragraph(e(f"{k}: {v}"), small) for k, v in report.versions.items()]
    story += [Paragraph(e(t("disclaimer")), styles["Heading2"]), Paragraph(e(report.disclaimer), small)]
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    SimpleDocTemplate(buffer, pagesize=A4, title=report.title).build(story)
    return buffer.getvalue()

    marscope.explain.ask ¶

    Ask: questions about one result, answered from the result and the policy notes.

    The suggested questions ("chips") get fixed answers built from the result, so they work offline and say the same thing for the same video. A free question goes to the configured LLM with the same facts as the report and the same filter (no numbers, no verdict, only references the rules attached). A question that asks for a verdict gets the fixed no-verdict answer and never reaches the LLM.

    def chip_answer(result: VideoResult, chip: str, language: str = "en") -> Answer:
    """Answer a suggested question from the result alone (no LLM, same every time).

    Parameters
    ----------
    result : VideoResult
        The result, with notes.
    chip : {"disagree", "tests", "certain", "verdict"}
        The suggested question.
    language : {"en", "fr"}
        Language.

    Returns
    -------
    Answer
        Text with ``[key]`` citations, only for references the rules attached.

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError
        For an unknown chip.
    """
    lang = language if language in TEXT else "en"
    allowed = {k for n in result.notes for k in n.references}

    def cite(*keys: str) -> str:
        return "".join(f" [{k}]" for k in keys if k in allowed)

    if chip == "deepfake":
        return card_answer(next(c for c in load_cards() if c.id == "deepfake"), lang)
    builders = {"disagree": _disagree, "tests": _tests, "certain": _certain, "verdict": _verdict}
    if chip not in builders:
        raise ValueError(f"chip must be one of {', '.join(CHIPS)}")
    text = builders[chip](result, lang, cite)
    keys = [k for k in dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r"\[([a-z0-9-]+)\]", text)) if k in allowed]
    return Answer(text=text, source="fixed", references=references(keys), refused=chip == "verdict")

    def ask(
    result: VideoResult,
    question: str,
    language: str = "en",
    experiments: list[Experiment] | None = None,
    timeout: float = 40.0,
) -> Answer:
    """Answer a free question with the configured LLM, from the result's facts only.

    Parameters
    ----------
    result : VideoResult
        The result, with notes.
    question : str
        The question.
    language : {"en", "fr"}
        Answer language.
    experiments : list of Experiment, optional
        Tests run in the session (sent as words, never as frames).
    timeout : float
        Seconds to wait for the LLM per attempt.

    Returns
    -------
    Answer
        The fixed no-verdict answer for a verdict question; otherwise the LLM's filtered
        answer, or an empty answer with ``llm_status`` saying why there is none.
    """
    lang = language if language in TEXT else "en"
    if asks_for_verdict(question):
        return chip_answer(result, "verdict", lang)
    hits = search(question)
    close = hits[0][0] if hits and hits[0][1] >= MATCH else None
    about = about_result(question)
    if close and not about:  # a general question: the reviewed card, never an LLM paraphrase
        return card_answer(close, lang)
    settings = llm_settings()
    if settings is None:
        strong = close is not None and hits[0][1] >= 2 * MATCH  # about this result: only a strong card match
        return card_answer(close, lang) if close and strong else Answer(text="", source="llm", llm_status="off")
    background = [c for c, score in hits if score >= MATCH / 2]
    allowed = sorted({k for n in result.notes for k in n.references} | {k for c in background for k in c.references})
    payload = llm_payload(result, experiments)
    payload["background"] = [
        {"question": c.text("question", "en"), "answer": c.text("answer", "en")} for c in background
    ]
    user = (
        "Reference keys you may cite: "
        + ", ".join(allowed)
        + "\n\nFacts:\n"
        + json.dumps(payload, indent=1)
        + "\n\nQuestion: "
        + question.strip()
    )
    raw, status = complete(ASK_PROMPT + (FRENCH if lang == "fr" else ""), user, settings, timeout=timeout)
    text = screen(raw or "", allowed)
    if not text and close is not None:  # the LLM failed or broke the rules: the closest reviewed card
        return card_answer(close, lang)
    if raw is not None and not text:
        status = "filtered"
    keys = [k for k in dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r"\[([a-z0-9-]+)\]", text)) if k in allowed]
    return Answer(
        text=text,
        source="llm",
        references=references(keys),
        llm={"model": settings["model"], "endpoint": endpoint_host(settings["base_url"])} if text else {},
        llm_status=status,
    )

    def tokens(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Split text into search terms: lower case, no accents, no stop words, stemmed.

    Parameters
    ----------
    text : str
        Text in English or French.

    Returns
    -------
    list of str
        Terms.

    Examples
    --------
    >>> tokens("What are Content Credentials (C2PA)?")
    ['content', 'credential', 'c2pa']
    >>> tokens("Qu’est-ce qu’un hypertrucage ?")
    ['hypertrucag']
    """
    folded = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text.lower().replace("’", "'"))
    folded = "".join(ch for ch in folded if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
    out = []
    for word in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", folded):
        if word in STOP or len(word) < 2:  # noqa: PLR2004 - single letters carry no meaning here
            continue
        out.append(stem(word))
    return out

    def stem(word: str) -> str:
    """Strip one common ending so that "shared", "sharing" and "share" match.

    Parameters
    ----------
    word : str
        A lower-case word.

    Returns
    -------
    str
        The stem (unchanged when it would be shorter than four letters).

    Examples
    --------
    >>> stem("sharing"), stem("shared"), stem("share"), stem("uploaded")
    ('shar', 'shar', 'shar', 'upload')
    """
    for suffix in SUFFIXES:
        if word.endswith(suffix) and len(word) - len(suffix) >= 4 and not word.endswith("ss"):  # noqa: PLR2004
            return word[: -len(suffix)]
    return word

def load_cards() -> tuple[Card, ...]:
    """Load the knowledge cards shipped with the package (cached).

    Returns
    -------
    tuple of Card
        Every card, in file order.
    """
    raw: dict[str, Any] = yaml.safe_load(
        files("marscope.explain").joinpath("knowledge.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )
    return tuple(
        Card(
            id=key,
            question=dict(card["q"]),
            answer=dict(card["answer"]),
            keywords=tuple(card.get("keywords", [])),
            references=tuple(card.get("references", [])),
            source=str(card.get("source", "")),
        )
        for key, card in raw["cards"].items()
    )

    def search(question: str, k: int = 3) -> list[tuple[Card, float]]:
    """Find the cards closest to a question (English or French), best first.

    Parameters
    ----------
    question : str
        The question.
    k : int
        Most cards returned.

    Returns
    -------
    list of (Card, float)
        Cards with a positive score, and the score. ``MATCH`` or more is a close match;
        a card whose question and keywords share no term with the question stays below
        ``MATCH`` whatever its answer says.

    Examples
    --------
    >>> search("What is a deepfake?")[0][0].id
    'deepfake'
    """
    docs, idf, avg = _index()
    query = tokens(question)
    k1, b = 1.5, 0.75
    scored = []
    asked = set(query)
    for card, doc, (q_sets, anchor) in zip(load_cards(), docs, _anchors(), strict=True):
        length = sum(doc.values())
        score = 0.0
        for term in query:
            tf = doc.get(term, 0)
            if tf:
                score += idf[term] * tf * (k1 + 1) / (tf + k1 * (1 - b + b * length / avg))
        if asked:  # how closely it asks the card's own question (1 when the same terms)
            score += MATCH * max(len(asked & q) / len(asked | q) for q in q_sets if q)
        if not anchor & asked:
            score = min(score, MATCH * 0.9)
        if score > 0:
            scored.append((card, round(score, 3)))
    scored.sort(key=lambda pair: -pair[1])
    return scored[:k]

    def get_spec(model_id: str) -> ModelSpec:
    """Return the spec for a model id.

    Parameters
    ----------
    model_id : str

        The model's spec.

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError

    Examples
    --------

    try:

    def parse_models(value: str | list[str] | None) -> list[str]:
    """Turn a comma-separated string or list into an ordered list of known model ids.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value : str or list of str or None
        For example ``"mars,gend"``. ``None`` or ``""`` selects MARS only (the default);
        ``"all"`` selects all three.

    Returns
    -------
    list of str
        Model ids in display order, without duplicates.

    Examples
    --------
    >>> parse_models("gend,mars")
    ['mars', 'gend']
    >>> parse_models(None)
    ['mars']
    >>> parse_models("all")
    ['mars', 'gend', 'dfd-hr']
    """
    if value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip()):
        return [MODEL_ORDER[0]]
    if value == "all":
        return list(MODEL_ORDER)
    items = value.split(",") if isinstance(value, str) else value
    wanted = {get_spec(item.strip().lower()).id for item in items if item.strip()}
    if not wanted:
        raise ValueError("select at least one model")
    return [m for m in MODEL_ORDER if m in wanted]

    class Runner:
    """One loaded model.

    Parameters
    ----------
    spec : ModelSpec
        The model.
    device : {"auto", "cuda", "cpu"}
        ``auto`` uses CUDA when available. fp16 on the GPU, fp32 on the CPU.
    device_id : int
        GPU index.
    precision : {"auto", "fp16", "fp32"}
        ``auto`` is fp16 on the GPU and fp32 on the CPU. fp16 is never used on the CPU.
    """

    def __init__(self, spec: ModelSpec, device: str = "auto", device_id: int = 0, precision: str = "auto") -> None:
        self.spec = spec
        self.device_note: str | None = None
        want_cuda = device == "cuda" or (device == "auto" and cuda_available())
        if device == "cuda" and not cuda_available():
            self.device_note = "CUDA was requested but this ONNX Runtime build has no CUDA provider"
        session: Any = None
        if want_cuda:
            _preload_cuda_libraries()
            cuda = ("CUDAExecutionProvider", {"device_id": device_id, **CUDA_OPTIONS})
            session = self._open("fp32" if precision == "fp32" else "fp16", [cuda, "CPUExecutionProvider"])
            if "CUDAExecutionProvider" not in session.get_providers():
                self.device_note = (
                    "CUDA could not be loaded (CUDA 12 or cuDNN 9 libraries missing), so the model runs on the CPU "
                    "with the fp32 file"
                )
                log.warning(
                    "%s: %s. Install the CUDA libraries with `uv sync --extra cuda` (or `pip install marscope[cuda]`)",
                    spec.name,
                    self.device_note,
                )
                session = None
        if session is None:
            session = self._open("fp32", ["CPUExecutionProvider"])
        self.session: Any = session
        self.device: Device = "cuda" if "CUDAExecutionProvider" in session.get_providers() else "cpu"
        if precision == "fp16" and self.device == "cpu" and self.device_note is None:
            self.device_note = "fp16 runs on the GPU only; on the CPU the model uses the fp32 file"
        self.protocol = self._read_protocol()
        self.ranges = UsualRanges.from_file(download(spec, FILES[self.precision][1]))
        self.serving: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(download(spec, "serving.json").read_text())
        self.run_options = ort.RunOptions()
        if self.device == "cuda":
            self.run_options.add_run_config_entry("memory.enable_memory_arena_shrinkage", f"gpu:{device_id}")

    def _open(self, precision: Precision, providers: list[Any]) -> Any:
        options = ort.SessionOptions()
        options.intra_op_num_threads = cpu_threads()
        options.log_severity_level = 3  # errors only; ORT warns about graph rewrites on every load
        path = download(self.spec, FILES[precision][0])
        self.commit = commit_of(path)
        self.precision: Precision = precision
        return ort.InferenceSession(str(path), sess_options=options, providers=providers)

    def _read_protocol(self) -> Protocol:
        meta = self.session.get_modelmeta().custom_metadata_map
        outputs = tuple(o.name for o in self.session.get_outputs())
        return Protocol(
            n_frames=int(meta["n_frames"]),
            frame_stride=int(meta["frame_stride"]),
            image_size=int(meta["image_size"]),
            outputs=outputs,
        )

    def run(self, frames: np.ndarray, n_valid: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
        """Score a batch of clips.

        Parameters
        ----------
        frames : numpy.ndarray
            (B, n_frames, 3, S, S) float32 in [-1, 1].
        n_valid : numpy.ndarray
            (B,) int64, real frames per clip.

        Returns
        -------
        dict of str to numpy.ndarray
            Every output of the graph: ``fake_prob``, ``logits`` and, per model,
            ``frame_contrib``, ``patch_contrib``, ``gate`` (MARS) or ``frame_probs``
            (GenD, DFD-HR).
        """
        feed = {
            "frames": np.ascontiguousarray(frames, dtype=np.float32),
            "n_valid": np.asarray(n_valid, dtype=np.int64),
        }
        values = self.session.run(list(self.protocol.outputs), feed, self.run_options)
        return dict(zip(self.protocol.outputs, values, strict=True))

    def peak_vram_gb(self, batch: int = 1) -> float:
        """Return the measured peak GPU memory for this file and batch size.

        Parameters
        ----------
        batch : int
            1 or 2.

        Returns
        -------
        float
            GiB, from ``serving.json``.
        """
        return peak_vram_gb(self.serving, self.precision, batch)

    def commit_of(path: Path) -> str:
    """Return the Hugging Face commit a downloaded file came from.

    The cache stores files under ``snapshots/<commit>/``; results print that commit.

    Parameters
    ----------
    path : Path
        A path returned by :func:`download`.

    Returns
    -------
    str
        The commit hash, or ``"unknown"`` for a file outside the cache.

    Examples
    --------
    >>> commit_of(Path("/c/models--x--y/snapshots/9baf809130e6/model.onnx"))
    '9baf809130e6'
    """
    parts = path.parts
    if "snapshots" in parts:
        i = parts.index("snapshots")
        if i + 1 < len(parts):
            return parts[i + 1]
    return "unknown"

    def cpu_threads() -> int:
    """Return the number of CPUs this process may use.

    ONNX Runtime otherwise sees every core on the machine, which oversubscribes shared
    nodes.

    Returns
    -------
    int
        Usable CPUs.
    """
    try:
        return len(os.sched_getaffinity(0))
    except AttributeError:  # not on Linux
        return os.cpu_count() or 1

    """Return whether this ONNX Runtime build has the CUDA execution provider.

    def peak_vram_gb(serving: dict[str, Any], precision: Precision, batch: int = 1) -> float:
    """Read a peak from a parsed ``serving.json``.

    Parameters
    ----------
    serving : dict
        Parsed ``serving.json``.

    Scheduler¶

    marscope.models.scheduler ¶

    Plan which models run together, from free GPU memory and each model's measured peak.

    Peaks come from serving.json (process totals including the CUDA context, so in one process the real total is lower and the plan is safe). Clips run at batch 1: batch 2 barely improves time per clip.

    def plan_waves(peaks_gb: Mapping[str, float], free_gb: float | None, sequential: bool = False) -> list[list[str]]:
    """Group models into waves that fit in free GPU memory, MARS first.

    Parameters
    ----------
    peaks_gb : mapping of str to float
        Model id to peak GiB at batch 1, in the order models should run.
    free_gb : float or None
        Free GPU memory; None (unknown, or CPU) runs one model at a time.
    sequential : bool
        Force one model at a time.

    Returns
    -------
    list of list of str
        Waves; models in a wave run in parallel, waves run one after another.

    Examples
    --------
    >>> peaks = {"mars": 2.93, "gend": 2.25, "dfd-hr": 2.55}
    >>> plan_waves(peaks, 10.0)
    [['mars', 'gend', 'dfd-hr']]
    >>> plan_waves(peaks, 8.0)
    [['mars', 'gend'], ['dfd-hr']]
    >>> plan_waves(peaks, 4.0)
    [['mars'], ['gend'], ['dfd-hr']]
    >>> plan_waves(peaks, None)
    [['mars'], ['gend'], ['dfd-hr']]
    """
    models: Sequence[str] = list(peaks_gb)
    if sequential or free_gb is None:
        return [[m] for m in models]
    waves: list[list[str]] = []
    current: list[str] = []
    used = HEADROOM_GB
    for model in models:
        peak = peaks_gb[model]
        if current and used + peak > free_gb:
            waves.append(current)
            current, used = [], HEADROOM_GB
        current.append(model)
        used += peak
    if current:
        waves.append(current)
    return waves

    def free_vram_gb(device_id: int = 0) -> float | None:
    """Free memory on one GPU, from ``nvidia-smi``.

    Parameters
    ----------
    device_id : int
        GPU index.

    Returns
    -------
    float or None
        Free GiB, or None when no NVIDIA GPU can be queried.
    """
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(
            ["nvidia-smi", f"--id={device_id}", "--query-gpu=memory.free", "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=10,
            check=True,
        ).stdout
        return float(out.strip().splitlines()[0]) / 1024
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError, ValueError, IndexError) as error:
        log.debug("nvidia-smi unavailable: %s", error)
        return None

    @dataclass
class Job:
    """One analysis job and its temporary files."""

    id: str
    folder: Path
    video: Path
    models: list[str]
    jurisdiction: str | None
    language: str
    status: str = "queued"
    error: str | None = None
    result: VideoResult | None = None
    events: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    touched: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    done: threading.Event = field(default_factory=threading.Event)
    lock: threading.Condition = field(default_factory=threading.Condition)
    experiments: dict[str, Experiment] = field(default_factory=dict)
    reports: dict[tuple[str, bool, int], Report] = field(default_factory=dict)
    cache: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)  # sweeps, probes and maps, computed once
    inflight: dict[str, threading.Event] = field(default_factory=dict)  # tests and maps being computed
    version: int = 0

    def record(self, key: str, experiment: Experiment) -> None:
        """Keep a test run of this session for the report (latest per key, at most 20).

        Parameters
        ----------
        key : str
            What makes two runs the same test (a repeat replaces the earlier run).
        experiment : Experiment
            The test and the scores measured.
        """
        with self.lock:
            self.experiments.pop(key, None)
            self.experiments[key] = experiment
            while len(self.experiments) > MAX_EXPERIMENTS:
                self.experiments.pop(next(iter(self.experiments)))
            self.changed()

    def changed(self) -> None:
        """Forget built reports after the experiments or the notes change."""
        self.version += 1
        self.reports.clear()

    def emit(self, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Record a progress event and wake the streams.

        Parameters
        ----------
        event : dict
            The event.
        """
        with self.lock:
            if event.get("type") == "stage":
                self.status = str(event.get("stage", self.status))
            self.events.append(event)
            self.lock.notify_all()

    class JobManager:
    """Queue jobs and run them one at a time on a worker thread.

    Parameters
    ----------
    toolkit : MARScope
        The loaded toolkit (shared by all jobs).
    limits : Limits
        Upload limits and job expiry.
    """

    def __init__(self, toolkit: MARScope, limits: Limits) -> None:
        self.toolkit = toolkit
        self.limits = limits
        self.jobs: dict[str, Job] = {}
        self.gpu = threading.Lock()  # one analysis, probe or load at a time
        self._queue: queue.Queue[str] = queue.Queue()
        self._root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="marscope-jobs-"))
        threading.Thread(target=self._work, daemon=True, name="marscope-worker").start()
        threading.Thread(target=self._expire, daemon=True, name="marscope-expiry").start()

    def submit(self, upload: UploadFile, models: list[str], jurisdiction: str | None, language: str) -> Job:
        """Validate an upload and queue it.

        Parameters
        ----------
        upload : UploadFile
            The uploaded video.
        models : list of str
            Models to run.
        jurisdiction : str or None
            Region for context notes.
        language : str
            Note language.

        Returns
        -------
        Job
            The queued job.

        Raises
        ------
        HTTPException
            400 or 413 when the upload is rejected; a rejected upload is never kept.
        """
        job_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
        folder = self._root / job_id
        folder.mkdir()
        video = folder / safe_name(upload.filename)
        try:
            size = 0
            with video.open("wb") as out:
                while chunk := upload.file.read(1024 * 1024):
                    size += len(chunk)
                    if size > self.limits.max_bytes:
                        raise HTTPException(413, f"the file is larger than {self.limits.max_bytes // 2**20} MB")
                    out.write(chunk)
            with video.open("rb") as f:
                kind = sniff_video(f.read(16))
            if kind is None:
                raise HTTPException(400, "the file is not an MP4, MOV or WebM video")
            try:
                meta = read_meta(video)
            except Exception as error:
                raise HTTPException(400, describe_read_error(error)) from error
            if meta.duration_s > self.limits.max_seconds:
                raise HTTPException(400, f"the video is longer than {self.limits.max_seconds:.0f} seconds")
            long_side, short_side = max(meta.width, meta.height), min(meta.width, meta.height)
            if long_side > self.limits.max_long_side or short_side > self.limits.max_short_side:
                raise HTTPException(400, "the video is larger than 1080p")
        except HTTPException:
            shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)
            raise
        job = Job(job_id, folder, video, models, jurisdiction, language)
        job.events.append({"type": "stage", "stage": "queued", "name": upload.filename})
        self.jobs[job_id] = job
        self._queue.put(job_id)
        return job

    def get(self, job_id: str) -> Job:
        """Return a job or raise 404.

        Parameters
        ----------
        job_id : str
            Job id.

        Returns
        -------
        Job
            The job.
        """
        job = self.jobs.get(job_id)
        if job is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "no such job (it may have expired)")
        job.touched = time.time()
        return job

    def result(self, job_id: str) -> tuple[Job, VideoResult]:
        """Return a finished job and its result, or raise 409 while it runs.

        Parameters
        ----------
        job_id : str
            Job id.

        Returns
        -------
        tuple of (Job, VideoResult)
            The job and its result.
        """
        job = self.get(job_id)
        if job.result is None:
            raise HTTPException(409, job.error or f"the job is {job.status}")
        return job, job.result

    def delete(self, job_id: str) -> None:
        """Delete a job's video and result now.

        Parameters
        ----------
        job_id : str
            Job id.
        """
        job = self.jobs.pop(job_id, None)
        if job is not None:
            shutil.rmtree(job.folder, ignore_errors=True)

    def _work(self) -> None:
        while True:
            job_id = self._queue.get()
            job = self.jobs.get(job_id)
            if job is None:
                continue
            try:
                with self.gpu:
                    job.result = self.toolkit.analyze(
                        job.video,
                        jurisdiction=job.jurisdiction,
                        language=job.language,
                        models=job.models,
                        progress=job.emit,
                        frames_dir=job.folder / "frames",
                    )
                job.emit({"type": "stage", "stage": "done"})
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - reported to the client as a failed job
                log.exception("job %s failed", job_id)
                job.error = friendly_error(error)
                job.emit({"type": "stage", "stage": "failed", "error": job.error})
            finally:
                with job.lock:
                    job.done.set()
                    job.lock.notify_all()

    def _expire(self) -> None:
        while True:
            time.sleep(60)
            now = time.time()
            for job_id, job in list(self.jobs.items()):
                if job.done.is_set() and now - job.touched > self.limits.job_ttl_seconds:
                    log.info("job %s expired", job_id)
                    self.delete(job_id)

    upload : UploadFile
        The uploaded video.
    models : list of str
        Models to run.
    jurisdiction : str or None
        Region for context notes.
    language : str
        Note language.

    Returns
    -------
    Job
        The queued job.

    Raises
    ------
    HTTPException
        400 or 413 when the upload is rejected; a rejected upload is never kept.
    """
    job_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
    folder = self._root / job_id
    folder.mkdir()
    video = folder / safe_name(upload.filename)
    try:
        size = 0
        with video.open("wb") as out:
            while chunk := upload.file.read(1024 * 1024):
                size += len(chunk)
                if size > self.limits.max_bytes:
                    raise HTTPException(413, f"the file is larger than {self.limits.max_bytes // 2**20} MB")
                out.write(chunk)
        with video.open("rb") as f:
            kind = sniff_video(f.read(16))
        if kind is None:
            raise HTTPException(400, "the file is not an MP4, MOV or WebM video")
        try:
            meta = read_meta(video)
        except Exception as error:
            raise HTTPException(400, describe_read_error(error)) from error
        if meta.duration_s > self.limits.max_seconds:
            raise HTTPException(400, f"the video is longer than {self.limits.max_seconds:.0f} seconds")
        long_side, short_side = max(meta.width, meta.height), min(meta.width, meta.height)
        if long_side > self.limits.max_long_side or short_side > self.limits.max_short_side:
            raise HTTPException(400, "the video is larger than 1080p")
    except HTTPException:
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)
        raise
    job = Job(job_id, folder, video, models, jurisdiction, language)
    job.events.append({"type": "stage", "stage": "queued", "name": upload.filename})
    self.jobs[job_id] = job
    self._queue.put(job_id)
    return job

    def get(self, job_id: str) -> Job:
    """Return a job or raise 404.

    Parameters
    ----------
    job_id : str
        Job id.

    Returns
    -------
    Job
        The job.
    """
    job = self.jobs.get(job_id)

    job.touched = time.time()

    def once(job: Job, key: str, compute: Callable[[], dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Compute a test or map once per job: cached after, and shared while it runs.

    The computation holds the GPU per pass (``guard`` in the pipeline), so the user's
    other requests run between passes. A second request for the same key while it
    runs waits for it instead of computing it again.

    Parameters
    ----------
    job : Job
        The job, whose cache holds the result.
    key : str
        What makes two requests the same.
    compute : callable
        Computes the result.

    Returns
    -------
    dict
        The result.
    """
    while True:
        with job.lock:
            cached = job.cache.get(key)
            if cached is not None:
                return cached
            running = job.inflight.get(key)
            mine = running is None
            if running is None:
                running = job.inflight[key] = threading.Event()
        if not mine:
            running.wait()
            continue  # cached now, or the other request failed and this one computes it
        try:
            out = compute()
            job.cache[key] = out
            return out
        finally:
            with job.lock:
                job.inflight.pop(key, None)
            running.set()

    def friendly_error(error: BaseException) -> str:
    """Turn an error from the models into a message a person can act on.

    Parameters
    ----------
    error : BaseException
        What the analysis or a test raised.

    Returns
    -------
    str
        The message (the error's own text when there is nothing clearer to say).

    Examples
    --------
    >>> message = friendly_error(RuntimeError("CUDA failure 2: out of memory"))
    >>> message.startswith("the GPU ran out of memory")
    True
    """
    text = str(error) or type(error).__name__
    lowered = text.lower()
    if "out of memory" in lowered or "failed to allocate" in lowered or "cudaerrormemoryallocation" in lowered:
        return GPU_OUT_OF_MEMORY
    return text

    def safe_name(filename: str | None) -> str:
    """Keep an upload's own name, reduced to safe characters.

    Parameters
    ----------
    filename : str or None
        Name sent by the browser.

    Returns
    -------
    str
        A plain file name with an extension.

    Examples
    --------
    >>> safe_name("../My clip (1).MP4")
    'My_clip_1.mp4'
    >>> safe_name(None)
    'video.mp4'
    """
    name = Path(filename or "video.mp4").name
    stem, suffix = Path(name).stem, Path(name).suffix.lower() or ".mp4"
    stem = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", stem).strip("._") or "video"
    return f"{stem[:80]}{suffix if re.fullmatch(r'\.[a-z0-9]{1,5}', suffix) else '.mp4'}"

    def sniff_video(head: bytes) -> str | None:
    """Recognize a video container from its first bytes, not its extension.

    Parameters
    ----------
    head : bytes
        At least the first 12 bytes of the file.

    Returns
    -------
    str or None
        ``mp4`` (MP4 and MOV share the ISO base media format), ``webm``, or None.

    Examples
    --------
    >>> sniff_video(b"\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x18ftypmp42")
    'mp4'
    >>> sniff_video(b"\\x1a\\x45\\xdf\\xa3" + b"\\x00" * 8)
    'webm'
    >>> sniff_video(b"GIF89a......") is None
    True
    """
    if len(head) >= 12 and head[4:8] in (b"ftyp", b"moov", b"mdat", b"wide", b"free"):
        return "mp4"
    if head[:4] == b"\x1a\x45\xdf\xa3":
        return "webm"
    return None

    def create_app(toolkit: MARScope | None = None, limits: Limits | None = None) -> FastAPI:  # noqa: PLR0915
    """Build the FastAPI app.

    Parameters
    ----------
    toolkit : MARScope, optional
        A toolkit to share; by default one with all three models (loaded on demand).
    limits : Limits, optional
        Upload limits.

    Returns
    -------
    FastAPI
        The app: web UI at ``/`` and ``/app``, API under the same port.
    """
    toolkit = toolkit or MARScope()
    manager = JobManager(toolkit, limits or Limits())
    app = FastAPI(title="MARScope", version=package_version(), docs_url="/api/docs", redoc_url=None)
    app.state.manager = manager
    app.state.ready = True  # serve() sets False while it preloads models in the background
    app.state.loading_model = None

    @app.get("/app", response_class=HTMLResponse, include_in_schema=False)
    def application() -> HTMLResponse:
        return HTMLResponse(WEB.joinpath("app.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    @app.get("/health")
    def health() -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Status, device and free GPU memory."""
        free = free_vram_gb(toolkit.device_id)
        settings = llm_settings()
        return {
            "status": "ok" if app.state.ready else "loading",
            "loading_model": app.state.loading_model,
            "version": package_version(),
            "gpu": free is not None,
            "free_vram_gb": round(free, 2) if free is not None else None,
            "loaded": toolkit.loaded(),
            "llm": settings is not None,
            "llm_model": settings["model"] if settings else None,
        }

    @app.get("/models")
    def models() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """List the models, which are loaded, and their measured cost (fp16)."""
        loaded = set(toolkit.loaded())
        return [
            {
                "id": m,
                "name": MODELS[m].name,
                "repo": MODELS[m].repo,
                "card": f"https://huggingface.co/{MODELS[m].repo}",
                "loaded": m in loaded,
                "built_in_attribution": MODELS[m].built_in_attribution,
                **serving_summary(m),
                "typical": typical_ranges(m),
                "benchmark": BENCHMARK["models"].get(m),
            }
            for m in MODEL_ORDER
        ]

    @app.get("/benchmark")
    def benchmark() -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return video AUROC (%) by test set and generator for the released models."""
        return BENCHMARK

    @app.get("/references")
    def all_references() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        """Every reference the policy can cite."""
        return references(list(load_policy()["references"]))

    @app.post("/models/{model_id}/load")
    def load_model(model_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Load a model ahead of time (the UI calls this when a box is ticked)."""
        try:
            parse_models(model_id)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise HTTPException(404, str(error)) from error
        with manager.gpu:
            runner = toolkit.load(model_id)
        return {
            "id": model_id,
            "device": runner.device,
            "precision": runner.precision,
            "device_note": runner.device_note,
            "peak_vram_gb": runner.peak_vram_gb(),
        }

    @app.post("/jobs", status_code=202)
    def create_job(
        video: UploadFile = File(...),  # noqa: B008 - FastAPI's way of declaring uploads
        models: str = Form("mars"),
        jurisdiction: str = Form(""),
        language: str = Form("en"),
    ) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Upload a video and start a job. Returns at once with the job id."""
        try:
            model_ids = parse_models(models)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise HTTPException(400, str(error)) from error
        region = jurisdiction.strip().lower() or None
        if region is not None and region not in JURISDICTIONS:
            raise HTTPException(400, f"jurisdiction must be one of {', '.join(JURISDICTIONS)}")
        if language not in ("en", "fr"):
            raise HTTPException(400, "language must be en or fr")
        job = manager.submit(video, model_ids, region, language)
        return {"id": job.id, "status": job.status}

    @app.get("/jobs/{job_id}/events")
    def events(job_id: str) -> StreamingResponse:
        """Progress as server-sent events, until the job is done or failed."""
        job = manager.get(job_id)

        def stream() -> Iterator[str]:
            sent = 0
            while True:
                with job.lock:
                    if sent >= len(job.events) and not job.done.is_set():
                        job.lock.wait(timeout=15)
                    pending = job.events[sent:]
                    finished = job.done.is_set()
                for event in pending:
                    yield f"data: {json.dumps(event)}\n\n"
                sent += len(pending)
                if finished:
                    return
                if not pending:
                    yield ": keep-alive\n\n"

        return StreamingResponse(stream(), media_type="text/event-stream", headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache"})

    @app.get("/jobs/{job_id}")
    def get_job(job_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Status, and the result when done: scores, evidence measures and notes."""
        job = manager.get(job_id)
        body: dict[str, Any] = {"id": job.id, "status": job.status, "error": job.error}
        if job.result is not None:
            body["result"] = job.result.model_dump(mode="json")
            body["references"] = references(sorted({k for n in job.result.notes for k in n.references}))
            body["ranges"] = {
                m: {k: [round(float(v), 5) for v in ev[f"{k}_percentiles"]] for k in ("real", "fake")}
                for m in job.result.models
                if "real_percentiles" in (ev := job.result.evidence(m))
            }
        return body

    @app.get("/jobs/{job_id}/frames/{frame}.jpg")
    def frame_image(job_id: str, frame: int) -> FileResponse:
        """Return a kept frame as a JPEG thumbnail."""
        path = manager.get(job_id).folder / "frames" / f"{frame:06d}.jpg"
        if not path.exists():
            raise HTTPException(404, "no such frame")
        return FileResponse(path, media_type="image/jpeg")

    @app.get("/jobs/{job_id}/maps/{model_id}/{clip}")
    def patch_maps(job_id: str, model_id: str, clip: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return MARS patch maps for one clip: one per real frame, and their sum."""
        _, result = manager.result(job_id)
        maps = result.evidence(model_id).get("patch_contrib")
        if not maps or clip >= len(maps):
            raise HTTPException(404, "no patch maps for this model and clip")
        arr: np.ndarray = maps[clip]
        return {
            "frames": np.round(arr, 5).tolist(),
            "clip": np.round(arr.sum(axis=0), 5).tolist(),
            "scale": float(np.abs(arr).max() or 1.0),
        }

    @app.post("/jobs/{job_id}/probe")
    def probe(job_id: str, body: ProbeRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Remove top frames or blank top patches of a clip, against random removal."""
        job, result = manager.result(job_id)
        if body.model not in result.models or body.clip >= len(result.models[body.model].clips):
            raise HTTPException(404, "no such model or clip in this result")
        key = f"probe:{body.kind}:{body.model}:{body.clip}"
        occ = occlusion_of(job, body.model, body.clip) if body.kind == "areas" else None
        try:
            out = once(
                job,
                key,
                lambda: toolkit.probe(
                    job.video, result, body.model, body.clip, body.kind, occlusion=occ, guard=manager.gpu
                ),
            )
        except ValueError as error:
            raise HTTPException(400, str(error)) from error
        if not body.record:
            return out
        kind: Literal["areas_test", "frames_test"] = "frames_test" if body.kind == "frames" else "areas_test"
        job.record(
            f"{kind}:{body.model}:{body.clip}",
            Experiment(
                kind=kind,
                clip=body.clip,
                model=body.model,
                hidden=int(out["count"]),
                before={body.model: out["before"]},
                after={body.model: out["after"]},
                random_after=out["random_after"],
            ),
        )
        return out

    @app.post("/jobs/{job_id}/rescore")
    def rescore(job_id: str, body: RescoreRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Score one clip again for every model, with some shown frames removed."""
        job, result = manager.result(job_id)
        if body.clip >= result.video.n_clips:
            raise HTTPException(404, "no such clip in this result")
        if not body.drop:
            return {
                "clip": body.clip,
                "drop": [],
                "scores": {m: s.clips[body.clip].fake for m, s in result.models.items()},
            }
        with manager.gpu:
            scores = toolkit.rescore(job.video, result, body.clip, sorted(set(body.drop)))
        drop = sorted(set(body.drop))
        job.record(
            f"frames:{body.clip}",
            Experiment(
                kind="frames",
                clip=body.clip,
                hidden=len(drop),
                frames=shown_frames(result, body.clip, drop),
                before={m: s.clips[body.clip].fake for m, s in result.models.items()},
                after=scores,
            ),
        )
        return {"clip": body.clip, "drop": drop, "scores": scores}

    @app.post("/jobs/{job_id}/edit")
    def edit(job_id: str, body: EditRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Score one clip again for every model after what-if edits."""
        job, result = manager.result(job_id)
        if body.clip >= result.video.n_clips:
            raise HTTPException(404, "no such clip in this result")
        with manager.gpu:
            scores = toolkit.edit_scores(job.video, result, body.clip, body.edits())
        settings = {k: float(v) for k, v in body.edits().as_dict().items()}
        if body.jpeg < 100 or body.scale < 100 or body.blur > 0 or body.noise > 0:
            job.record(
                f"edit:{body.clip}:{sorted(settings.items())}",
                Experiment(
                    kind="edit",
                    clip=body.clip,
                    settings=settings,
                    before={m: s.clips[body.clip].fake for m, s in result.models.items()},
                    after=scores,
                ),
            )
        return {"clip": body.clip, "edits": body.edits().as_dict(), "scores": scores}

    @app.post("/jobs/{job_id}/quality-sweep")
    def quality_sweep(job_id: str, body: EditRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Score one clip at several JPEG qualities, the other edits fixed."""
        job, result = manager.result(job_id)
        if body.clip >= result.video.n_clips:
            raise HTTPException(404, "no such clip in this result")
        with manager.gpu:
            scores = toolkit.quality_sweep(job.video, result, body.clip, body.edits())
        return {"clip": body.clip, "qualities": list(QUALITIES), "scores": scores}

    @app.get("/jobs/{job_id}/edited/{frame}.jpg")
    def edited_image(  # noqa: PLR0913, PLR0917
        job_id: str,
        frame: int,
        jpeg: int = Query(100, ge=10, le=100),
        scale: int = Query(100, ge=25, le=100),
        blur: float = Query(0.0, ge=0, le=3),
        noise: float = Query(0.0, ge=0, le=0.1),
    ) -> Response:
        """Return a preview of a kept frame with what-if edits (from its thumbnail)."""
        job, result = manager.result(job_id)
        path = job.folder / "frames" / f"{frame:06d}.jpg"
        if not path.exists():
            raise HTTPException(404, "no such frame")
        with Image.open(path) as img:
            rgb = np.asarray(img.convert("RGB"))
        out = apply_edits(
            rgb, Edits(jpeg, scale, blur, noise), seed=frame, pixel_scale=rgb.shape[0] / result.video.height
        )
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        Image.fromarray(out).save(buf, format="JPEG", quality=95)
        return Response(buf.getvalue(), media_type="image/jpeg")

    @app.post("/jobs/{job_id}/sweep")
    def sweep(job_id: str, body: SweepRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Score a clip as more of the model's top frames go, versus random."""
        job, result = manager.result(job_id)
        if body.model not in result.models or body.clip >= len(result.models[body.model].clips):
            raise HTTPException(404, "no such model or clip in this result")
        out = once(
            job,
            f"sweep:{body.model}:{body.clip}",
            lambda: toolkit.sweep(job.video, result, body.model, body.clip, guard=manager.gpu),
        )
        k = min(TOP_FRAMES, len(out["top"]) - 1)
        if body.record and k > 0:
            job.record(
                f"frames_test:{body.model}:{body.clip}",
                Experiment(
                    kind="frames_test",
                    clip=body.clip,
                    model=body.model,
                    hidden=k,
                    frames=shown_frames(result, body.clip, list(out["order"][:k])),
                    before={body.model: float(out["top"][0])},
                    after={body.model: float(out["top"][k])},
                    random_after=float(out["random"][k]),
                ),
            )
        return out

    @app.post("/jobs/{job_id}/occlusion")
    def occlusion(job_id: str, body: OcclusionRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Compute an 8 x 8 occlusion map for one clip (64 passes; slow on DFD-HR)."""
        job, result = manager.result(job_id)
        if body.model not in result.models or body.clip >= len(result.models[body.model].clips):
            raise HTTPException(404, "no such model or clip in this result")
        grid = occlusion_of(job, body.model, body.clip)
        if body.record:
            flat = max((v for row in grid for v in row), default=0.0) < FLAT_MAP
            job.record(
                f"occlusion:{body.model}:{body.clip}",
                Experiment(kind="occlusion", clip=body.clip, model=body.model, flat=flat),
            )
        return {"model": body.model, "clip": body.clip, "map": grid}

    def occlusion_of(job: Job, model_id: str, clip: int) -> list[list[float]]:
        """Return a clip's occlusion map, computed once per job and cached."""
        out = once(
            job,
            f"occlusion:{model_id}:{clip}",
            lambda: {"map": toolkit.occlusion(job.video, model_id, clip, guard=manager.gpu)},
        )
        grid: list[list[float]] = out["map"]
        return grid

    @app.post("/jobs/{job_id}/report", response_model=None)
    def report(job_id: str, body: ReportRequest) -> Response | dict[str, Any]:
        """Build the report, with the session's tests, as JSON, Markdown, HTML or PDF.

        The built report is kept until the tests or the notes change, so every export
        of one report has the same summary (the LLM is asked once).
        """
        job, result = manager.result(job_id)
        key = (body.language, body.use_llm, job.version)
        built = job.reports.get(key)
        if built is None:
            experiments = list(job.experiments.values())
            built = build_report(result, use_llm=body.use_llm, experiments=experiments, language=body.language)
            job.reports[key] = built
        stem = Path(result.video.name).stem or "video"
        if body.frame is not None and body.format in ("html", "pdf"):
            built = with_frame(built, job, result, body.frame)
        if body.format == "markdown":
            return Response(to_markdown(built), media_type="text/markdown", headers=_download(f"{stem}-report.md"))
        if body.format == "html":
            return HTMLResponse(to_html(built), headers=_download(f"{stem}-report.html"))
        if body.format == "pdf":
            return Response(to_pdf(built), media_type="application/pdf", headers=_download(f"{stem}-report.pdf"))
        return {
            "title": built.title,
            "summary": built.summary,
            "summary_source": built.summary_source,
            "by": built.by_line,
            "llm_status": built.llm_status,
            "rows": built.rows,
            "experiments": built.experiments,
            "records": [e.model_dump(mode="json") for e in job.experiments.values()],
            "notes": [n.model_dump(mode="json") for n in built.notes],
            "references": built.refs,
            "versions": built.versions,
            "llm": built.llm,
            "payload": built.payload,
            "disclaimer": built.disclaimer,
            "markdown": to_markdown(built),
        }

    @app.post("/jobs/{job_id}/ask")
    def ask_question(job_id: str, body: AskRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Answer a suggested question from the result, or a free one with the LLM."""
        job, result = manager.result(job_id)
        if (body.chip is None) == (body.question is None):
            raise HTTPException(422, f"send either chip ({', '.join(CHIPS)}) or question")
        if body.chip is not None:
            answer = chip_answer(result, body.chip, body.language)
        else:
            answer = ask(result, body.question or "", body.language, list(job.experiments.values()))
        return {
            "text": answer.text,
            "source": answer.source,
            "references": answer.references,
            "llm": answer.llm,
            "llm_status": answer.llm_status,
            "refused": answer.refused,
        }

    @app.post("/jobs/{job_id}/notes")
    def notes(job_id: str, body: NotesRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Re-apply the policy for another region or language. Scores do not change."""
        job, result = manager.result(job_id)
        result.notes = apply_policy(result, body.jurisdiction, body.language)
        result.reading = assess(result, body.language)
        result.jurisdiction = body.jurisdiction
        job.result = result
        job.changed()
        return {
            "notes": [n.model_dump(mode="json") for n in result.notes],
            "reading": result.reading.model_dump(mode="json"),
            "references": references(sorted({k for n in result.notes for k in n.references})),
        }

    @app.delete("/jobs/{job_id}", status_code=204)
    def delete_job(job_id: str) -> Response:
        """Delete the video and the result now."""
        manager.get(job_id)
        manager.delete(job_id)
        return Response(status_code=204)

    @app.exception_handler(HTTPException)
    def http_error(_request: Any, error: HTTPException) -> JSONResponse:
        return JSONResponse({"error": error.detail}, status_code=error.status_code)

    @app.exception_handler(Exception)
    def unexpected_error(_request: Any, error: Exception) -> JSONResponse:
        log.exception("request failed")
        return JSONResponse({"error": friendly_error(error)}, status_code=500)

    # The web UI last, at the root: relative links work served and opened as files.
    app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=str(WEB), html=True), name="web")
    return app

    def typical_ranges(model_id: str) -> dict[str, float] | None:
    """Return typical benchmark scores: real median, real 95th percentile, fake median.

    Parameters
    ----------
    model_id : str
        Model id.

    Returns
    -------
    dict or None
        ``real_p50``, ``real_p95``, ``fake_p50``, or None when the file cannot be read.
    """
    try:
        ranges = UsualRanges.from_file(download(MODELS[model_id], "usual_ranges.fp16.json"))
    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - offline or not yet downloaded
        log.debug("ranges for %s unavailable: %s", model_id, error)
        return None
    return {
        "real_p50": round(float(ranges.real[50]), 4),
        "real_p95": round(float(ranges.real[95]), 4),
        "fake_p50": round(float(ranges.fake[50]), 4),
    }

    def serving_summary(model_id: str) -> dict[str, float | None]:
    """Measured peak memory and time per clip for the fp16 file, from ``serving.json``.

    Parameters
    ----------
    model_id : str
        Model id.

    dict
        ``peak_vram_gb`` and ``seconds_per_clip`` (None when the file cannot be read).

    try:
        serving = json.loads(download(MODELS[model_id], "serving.json").read_text())
        fp16 = serving["files"]["model.fp16.onnx"]
        return {"peak_vram_gb": fp16["peak_vram_gb"]["batch1"], "seconds_per_clip": fp16["seconds_per_clip"]["batch1"]}
    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - offline or not yet downloaded
        log.debug("serving.json for %s unavailable: %s", model_id, error)
        return {"peak_vram_gb": None, "seconds_per_clip": None}

    def with_frame(report: Report, job: Job, result: VideoResult, frame: int) -> Report:
    """Return a copy of a report showing one kept frame (its thumbnail) and a caption.

    Parameters
    ----------
    report : Report
        The built report (kept unchanged in the cache).
    job : Job
        The job, whose folder holds the thumbnails.
    result : VideoResult
        Its result (to find the clip).
    frame : int
        Kept frame index in the original video.

    Returns
    -------
    Report
        The copy with ``frame`` and ``frame_caption`` set.
    """
    path = job.folder / "frames" / f"{frame:06d}.jpg"
    if not path.exists():
        raise HTTPException(404, "no such frame")
    clips = next(iter(result.models.values())).clips
    clip = next((c.index for c in clips if c.first_frame <= frame <= c.last_frame), 0)
    caption = tr(report.language, "frame_cap", n=frame + 1, c=clip + 1)
    return replace(report, frame=path.read_bytes(), frame_caption=caption)

    def serve(
    host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 8000, toolkit: MARScope | None = None, preload: list[str] | None = None
) -> None:
    """Run the local server (``marscope --serve``).

    Parameters
    ----------
    host : str
        Interface to bind; 127.0.0.1 keeps it local.
    port : int
        Port.
    toolkit : MARScope, optional
        MARScope to use.
    preload : list of str, optional
        Models to load at start (MARS by default), with one warm-up.
    """
    import uvicorn  # noqa: PLC0415

    toolkit = toolkit or MARScope()
    app = create_app(toolkit)
    app.state.ready = False

    def warm_up() -> None:
        try:
            with app.state.manager.gpu:
                for model_id in preload if preload is not None else ["mars"]:
                    app.state.loading_model = model_id
                    log.info("loading %s", model_id)
                    toolkit.load(model_id)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - the server still starts; jobs load models on demand
            log.exception("preloading failed")
        finally:
            app.state.loading_model = None
            app.state.ready = True

    threading.Thread(target=warm_up, daemon=True, name="marscope-warm-up").start()
    uvicorn.run(app, host=host, port=port, log_level="info")

    def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """Build the argument parser.

    Returns
    -------
    argparse.ArgumentParser
        The parser.
    """
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="marscope",
        description="See what a video deepfake detector sees. An educational tool: scores are model outputs.",
    )
    source = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    source.add_argument("--video", type=Path, help="analyze one video file")
    source.add_argument("--serve", action="store_true", help="run the local UI and REST API")
    parser.add_argument("--models", default=None, help="mars (default), gend, dfd-hr, comma-separated, or all")
    parser.add_argument("--sequential", action="store_true", help="run one model at a time to fit a small GPU")
    parser.add_argument("--device", choices=["auto", "cuda", "cpu"], default="auto")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--precision",
        choices=["auto", "fp16", "fp32"],
        default="auto",
        help="model file on the GPU: auto is fp16 (default); the CPU always runs fp32",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--jurisdiction", choices=JURISDICTIONS, help="region for context notes")
    parser.add_argument("--language", choices=["en", "fr"], default="en")
    parser.add_argument("--no-faces", action="store_true", help="skip face detection (A1 and the A3 face checks)")
    output = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    output.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="print the full result as JSON")
    output.add_argument("--report", choices=["markdown", "html", "pdf"], help="write a report next to the video")
    parser.add_argument("--no-llm", action="store_true", help="use the template report even if an LLM is set up")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--env-file", type=Path, help="settings file with the MARSCOPE_LLM_* values (default: .env in this folder)"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8000)
    parser.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true")
    return parser

    def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    """Run the command line.

    Parameters
    ----------
    argv : list of str, optional
        Arguments (defaults to ``sys.argv``).

    Returns
    -------
    int
        Exit code.
    """
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO if args.verbose else logging.WARNING, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")
    if args.env_file is not None:
        if not args.env_file.is_file():
            print(f"marscope: {args.env_file} does not exist", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        os.environ["MARSCOPE_ENV_FILE"] = str(args.env_file.resolve())
    from marscope.pipeline import MARScope  # noqa: PLC0415 - keep --help fast

    try:
        models = parse_models(args.models)
    except ValueError as error:
        print(f"marscope: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    toolkit = MARScope(
        models=models,
        device=args.device,
        sequential=args.sequential,
        faces=not args.no_faces,
        precision=args.precision,
    )

    if args.serve:
        from marscope.api import serve  # noqa: PLC0415

        preload = models if args.models != "all" else ["mars"]  # with all, the others load when picked
        print(serve_banner(args.host, args.port))
        serve(host=args.host, port=args.port, toolkit=toolkit, preload=preload)
        return 0

    if not args.video.exists():
        print(f"marscope: {args.video} does not exist", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    def progress(event: dict[str, object]) -> None:
        if args.json:
            return
        if event.get("type") == "stage" and event.get("stage") == "loading":
            print(f"loading {event['model']}…", file=sys.stderr)
        elif event.get("type") == "clip":
            print(f"\r{event['model']}: clip {event['done']}", end="", file=sys.stderr)

    import av  # noqa: PLC0415

    from marscope.video.preprocess import describe_read_error, read_meta  # noqa: PLC0415

    try:
        for warning in size_warnings(read_meta(args.video), len(models)):
            print(f"marscope: {warning}", file=sys.stderr)
        result = toolkit.analyze(args.video, jurisdiction=args.jurisdiction, language=args.language, progress=progress)
    except (ValueError, av.FFmpegError) as error:
        print(f"marscope: could not read {args.video.name}: {describe_read_error(error)}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    if not args.json:
        print(file=sys.stderr)
    if args.json:
        print(result.model_dump_json(indent=2))
    elif args.report:
        _write_report(args, result)
    else:
        print(format_summary(result.model_dump(mode="json")))
    return 0

    def size_warnings(meta: "VideoMeta", n_models: int) -> list[str]:
    """Warn when a video is past the web app's limits; the CLI still analyzes it.

    Parameters
    ----------
    meta : VideoMeta
        From :func:`marscope.video.preprocess.read_meta`.
    n_models : int
        Models that will run.

    Returns
    -------
    list of str
        Warnings (empty for a video the web app would take).
    """
    from marscope.video.preprocess import MAX_LONG_SIDE, MAX_SECONDS, MAX_SHORT_SIDE  # noqa: PLC0415

    out = []
    long_side, short_side = max(meta.width, meta.height), min(meta.width, meta.height)
    if meta.duration_s > MAX_SECONDS:
        clips = math.ceil(meta.duration_s * (meta.fps or 30) / 2 / 64)
        out.append(
            f"the video is {meta.duration_s:.0f} s, longer than the web app's {MAX_SECONDS:.0f} s limit: about "
            f"{clips} clips for each of {n_models} model(s), so this can take many minutes"
        )
    if long_side > MAX_LONG_SIDE or short_side > MAX_SHORT_SIDE:
        out.append(f"the video is {meta.width}x{meta.height}, above 1080p: decoding is slower and uses more memory")
    return out

    def serve_banner(host: str, port: int) -> str:
    """Return the ``--serve`` start message: the link, and how to reach it remotely.

    Parameters
    ----------
    host : str
        Interface the server listens on.
    port : int
        Port.

    Returns
    -------
    str
        One or two lines.

    Examples
    --------
    >>> serve_banner("127.0.0.1", 8000)
    'MARScope at http://localhost:8000/app  (the video stays on this machine)'
    """
    local = host in ("127.0.0.1", "localhost", "0.0.0.0", "::")  # noqa: S104 - only compared, never bound here
    lines = [f"MARScope at http://{'localhost' if local else host}:{port}/app  (the video stays on this machine)"]
    if host in ("0.0.0.0", "::"):  # noqa: S104
        name = socket.gethostname()
        lines.append(
            f"Listening on all interfaces. From another machine, open http://{name}:{port}/app or forward a port: "
            f"ssh -N -L 8010:{name}:{port} <user>@<login-host>, then http://localhost:8010/app"
        )
    return "\n".join(lines)

    def format_summary(result: dict[str, object]) -> str:
    """Plain-text summary for the terminal.

    Parameters
    ----------
    result : dict
        ``VideoResult.model_dump(mode="json")``.

    Returns
    -------
    str
        Scores in context and the notes.
    """
    video = result["video"]
    assert isinstance(video, dict)
    lines = [
        f"{video['name']}  {video['duration_s']:.1f} s  {video['width']}x{video['height']}  {video['n_clips']} clips",
        "",
    ]
    reading = result.get("reading")
    if isinstance(reading, dict):
        lines += [str(reading["headline"]), *reading["reasons"], str(reading["action"]), ""]
    models = result["models"]
    assert isinstance(models, dict)
    for score in models.values():
        ctx = score["context"]
        label, odds = rarity(ctx["real_rank"], score["name"])
        low, high = (round(v * 100) for v in ctx["real_range"])
        lines.append(
            f"{score['name']:<7} probability of fake {round(score['fake'] * 100)}%  "
            f"[{score['device']} {score['precision']}]",
        )
        lines.append(f"        {label}: {odds} (real videos usually {low}–{high}%)")
        if score.get("device_note"):
            lines.append(f"        note: {score['device_note']}")
    lines.append("")
    notes = result["notes"]
    assert isinstance(notes, list)
    for note in notes:
        prefix = {"at_risk": "!", "breaks": "!", "partly": "~", "holds": "-", "info": " "}[note["state"]]
        lines.append(f"{prefix} {note['text']}")
    lines += ["", "Scores are model outputs and can be wrong. Use --json for every value and detail."]
    return "\n".join(lines)

Its scores are model outputs, not findings: they can be wrong, and they are not evidence that a video is real or fake.
